notes: New in the Lab tab: Check My Answers. Do the lab problem on paper first, then type in the values it gave you and the answers you got — StudyLens checks them with the same maths and classic-trap spotting as practice (wrong-side tick, dip direction vs opposite strike, E/W mirror, swapped volumes), and shows the one worked step for any item you miss, only after you submit.
Seven checkers: strike & dip, cross section, topo relief & gradient, titration & solution prep, vector resultants, angles & bearings, and general numeric problems.

Nothing you type into the checker is stored or sent, and there is no photo input there by design — it checks work you have already done. Everything else is unchanged: photos are still read on-device only to detect the lab type and dropped when practice starts, and notes stay on this device only.
